tagline: Turning Market Data Into Market Intelligence.

events.title: Huntington Bank: What Will the Federal Reserve Do Next?
events.summary: Randy Hare, Director of Equity Research at Huntington Bank, provided insights on the strong Q2 earnings season, a calm week on Wall Street, and the August jobs report. His analysis, featured in Huntington's "The Three Things We Learned This Week" blog, discusses implications for the Federal Reserve's upcoming interest rate decision.

articles.headline: Huntington Bank: What Will the Federal Reserve Do Next?

events.title: The EU has cleared the acquisition of a real estate asset by Prologis and NBIM
events.summary: The European Commission has approved the acquisition of joint control of a logistics real estate asset in Hamburg by Prologis (United States) and NBIM Nerva (Norway). The transaction, which concerns the operation and management of industrial real estate, was reviewed under a simplified merger control procedure. The Commission concluded that the acquisition would not raise competition concerns due to the companies' limited market positions post-transaction.

articles.headline: The EU has cleared the acquisition of a real estate asset by Prologis and NBIM

events.title: Boeing, Gulfstream and West Star detail big aerospace investments in St. Louis region.
events.summary: Boeing, Gulfstream Aerospace Corp., and West Star Aviation are making significant investments in facilities, technology, and workforce development in the St. Louis region, solidifying its role as a major aerospace hub. These investments include Boeing's expansion for defense programs, Gulfstream's growth in aircraft completions, and West Star Aviation's MRO facility improvements. All three companies emphasize the critical need for workforce development and collaborative efforts to sustain the region's aerospace momentum.

articles.headline: Boeing, Gulfstream and West Star detail big aerospace investments in St. Louis region.

events.title: Freeport-McMoRan shares surge as copper hits record $14,694/ton
events.summary: Freeport-McMoRan shares surged after copper hit a new all-time high of $14,694 per ton on the LME, driven by supply pressures including accelerated US-bound metal flows and reduced production from Chile. This price surge significantly boosts Freeport-McMoRan's potential EBITDA, with management projecting higher earnings at elevated copper prices. The copper rally's continuation hinges on upcoming economic data, specifically the European Central Bank meeting and US inflation figures.

articles.headline: Freeport-McMoRan shares surge as copper hits record $14,694/ton

events.title: Why investors may want to ignore some market headlines
events.summary: Invesco's Chief Global Market Strategist suggests that investors should look beyond market headlines concerning oil prices, interest rates, and Federal Reserve actions. He argues that current market concerns are often overblown when viewed in context and that underlying fundamentals like resilient corporate earnings and significant AI investments are more critical drivers of market performance. Levitt advises focusing on these deeper economic supports rather than headline-driven pessimism.

articles.headline: Why investors may want to ignore some market headlines

events.title: Marathon Petroleum Corp stock hits all-time high at $398.68 USD
events.summary: Marathon Petroleum Corp (MPC) stock reached an all-time high of $398.68, reflecting strong investor confidence and a 117.44% increase over the past year. Despite appearing overvalued by InvestingPro analysis, the company reported strong Q2 2026 results, surpassing Wall Street expectations with earnings of $17.73 per share and $52.34 billion in revenue. Analysts from Freedom Broker and UBS upgraded their ratings and raised price targets, citing robust refining margins and operational execution.

articles.headline: Marathon Petroleum Corp stock hits all-time high at $398.68 USD

events.title: Virginia groups push for in-person hearings, longer review of Dominion-NextEra merger
events.summary: A coalition of nine Virginia advocacy groups has called for in-person public hearings and an extended review period for the proposed Dominion Energy-NextEra merger. While not opposing the merger itself, the groups want the Virginia State Corporation Commission to hold at least four hearings and plan to ask Gov. Abigail Spanberger to call a special session to extend the current 180-day review deadline.

articles.headline: Virginia groups push for in-person hearings, longer review of Dominion-NextEra merger

events.title: Labcorp acquires MLM Medical Labs to expand global network
events.summary: Labcorp has acquired MLM Medical Labs, a central and specialty laboratory provider with operations in the United States, Germany, and South Africa. This acquisition expands Labcorp's global network, making it the only central laboratory provider with a wholly owned laboratory network across four continents. The deal enhances Labcorp's clinical research capabilities and adds biomarker and specialty testing, supporting multinational clinical trials.

articles.headline: Labcorp acquires MLM Medical Labs to expand global network

events.title: CMS Energy (NYSE:CMS) faces a fresh market test as trading resumes today
events.summary: CMS Energy (NYSE:CMS) is under market scrutiny as U.S. equities reopen after Labor Day, with inflation expectations and interest rates influencing utility stocks. The company, which focuses on regulated electric and natural-gas utility operations in Michigan, will be evaluated based on grid spending, power demand, and reliability programs. Traders will be looking for company-specific execution to differentiate performance amidst broader macroeconomic trends and global market moves.

articles.headline: CMS Energy (NYSE:CMS) faces a fresh market test as trading resumes today

events.title: Chevron Stock Is Near a Record High. Here’s Why the Rally May Not Be Over
events.summary: Chevron's stock has surged over 42% this year, nearing a record high, but 24/7 Wall St. maintains a "Hold" recommendation with a target implying slight downside. While strong Q2 FY26 results, operational efficiencies, and a significant power purchase agreement with Microsoft present a bullish case, the stock's high P/E ratio compared to peers and potential oil price fluctuations suggest caution. The long-term projections depend on continued execution and market conditions.

articles.headline: Chevron Stock Is Near a Record High. Here’s Why the Rally May Not Be Over

events.title: Nucor Corp stock faces tariff headwinds as valuation stretches
events.summary: Nucor Corp's stock is currently trading at a 39.8% premium to its estimated intrinsic value, according to one valuation model, and faces new Canadian tariffs on U.S. steel and aluminum. These tariffs, ranging from 15% to 50% on approximately USD 20 billion of U.S. imports, could increase costs and reduce Nucor's competitiveness in the Canadian market. Additionally, insider selling totaling about USD 57 million over the past year, with no insider purchases, further complicates the investment outlook despite analysts generally remaining positive on the company's long-term prospects.

articles.headline: Nucor Corp stock faces tariff headwinds as valuation stretches

events.title: Why is Matador Resources (NYSE:MTDR) stock in focus as Wall Street reopens today?
events.summary: Matador Resources (NYSE:MTDR) is in focus as Wall Street reopens after Labor Day, with crude markets elevated due to conflict around the Strait of Hormuz. The company, which specializes in oil and natural-gas development in the Permian Basin, is being watched in the context of broader energy market conditions, geopolitical supply concerns, inflation, and interest rate expectations. The article emphasizes that investors should carefully assess business fundamentals as market dynamics interact with the company's operating model, competitive position, and capital needs.

articles.headline: Why is Matador Resources (NYSE:MTDR) stock in focus as Wall Street reopens today?

events.title: Bloom Energy, Everpure, Illumina to Join S&P 500 in September Rebalance
events.summary: Bloom Energy, Everpure, and Illumina are slated to be added to the S&P 500 index during its September rebalance. The article, published by MT Newswires, indicates this significant change for the companies involved. Full details are reserved for members of the platform.

articles.headline: Bloom Energy, Everpure, Illumina to Join S&P 500 in September Rebalance

events.title: Bull of the Day: Marathon Petroleum (MPC)
events.summary: Marathon Petroleum (MPC) has been identified as a "Strong Buy" due to an anticipated 341% year-over-year earnings growth, driven by record-high crack spreads in the refining industry. The company reported strong Q2 2026 results, beating analyst expectations, and is returning significant cash to shareholders through repurchases and dividends. Despite a 125% increase in share price year-to-date, MPC remains undervalued with a low P/E ratio and strong Zacks Style Scores for Value, Momentum, and Growth.

articles.headline: Bull of the Day: Marathon Petroleum (MPC)

events.title: VIRGINIA RETIREMENT SYSTEMS ET Al Acquires New Shares in Essex Property Trust, Inc. $ESS
events.summary: Virginia Retirement Systems acquired 107,012 shares of Essex Property Trust, Inc. (ESS) worth approximately $31.2 million in the second quarter, increasing institutional ownership to 96.51%. Essex Property Trust reported strong quarterly earnings, beating analyst estimates, and provided positive guidance for the third quarter and full year 2026. The company also declared a quarterly dividend of $2.59 per share, representing a 3.7% yield, while analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" consensus rating with an average target price of $304.79.

articles.headline: VIRGINIA RETIREMENT SYSTEMS ET Al Acquires New Shares in Essex Property Trust, Inc. $ESS

events.title: VIRGINIA RETIREMENT SYSTEMS ET Al Acquires New Shares in Analog Devices, Inc. $ADI
events.summary: Virginia Retirement Systems acquired 40,660 shares of Analog Devices (NASDAQ:ADI) worth approximately $16.1 million in Q2, contributing to institutional investors owning 86.81% of the company. Analog Devices reported strong Q2 earnings, beating estimates with $3.45 EPS and a 39.2% year-over-year revenue increase to $4.02 billion. Analysts maintain a "Buy" rating with an average price target of $454.63, significantly above the current share price of $362.25.

articles.headline: VIRGINIA RETIREMENT SYSTEMS ET Al Acquires New Shares in Analog Devices, Inc. $ADI

events.title: PG&E (PCG) and Edison (EIX) Sink After California Wildfire Liability Deal Falls Apart
events.summary: PG&E (PCG) and Edison (EIX) shares plunged after California lawmakers introduced a bill updating wildfire response that failed to shift liability away from publicly traded utilities, omitting Governor Gavin Newsom's proposal to prevent insurers from suing utilities. This omission led to analyst downgrades and PG&E announcing a strategic review and a $2 billion cut to its 2027 capital investment plan. While future legislative reforms could offer a rebound, unresolved wildfire liabilities are expected to remain a significant challenge for both companies.

articles.headline: PG&E (PCG) and Edison (EIX) Sink After California Wildfire Liability Deal Falls Apart

events.title: How Is Bank of Montreal (TSX:BMO) Navigating Market Changes?
events.summary: Bank of Montreal (TSX:BMO) is navigating market changes by leveraging its strong commercial and corporate banking operations. The bank benefits from commercial lending, which expands with business growth and rising interest rates, and its investment banking and capital markets services provide diverse revenue streams. BMO's diversified revenue and prudent risk management are key to its resilience in the evolving Canadian financial landscape.

articles.headline: How Is Bank of Montreal (TSX:BMO) Navigating Market Changes?

events.title: Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA): Can Beauty Demand Defy Inflation?
events.summary: Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA) faces a market where consumer demand for beauty products and services will be tested against rising inflation and changing interest rates. As U.S. equity markets were closed for Labor Day, the company's next active trading session will highlight execution, demand quality, and balance-sheet flexibility. The article emphasizes that Ulta's operating model, which combines cosmetics, skincare, hair care, fragrance, and salon services, must support consistent customer activity despite uneven broader sector conditions and increased consumer selectivity.

articles.headline: Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ:ULTA): Can Beauty Demand Defy Inflation?

events.title: Illinois Tool Works (NYSE:ITW): Is the Next Move About Demand?
events.summary: With U.S. equity markets closed for Labor Day, attention for Illinois Tool Works (NYSE:ITW) shifts to order activity, factory demand, automation, and infrastructure spending ahead of upcoming inflation data. The company's performance is closely tied to its specialized industrial products and equipment across manufacturing and service end markets. The article emphasizes that business fundamentals, operating quality, and balance sheet flexibility will be key drivers, especially as the macroeconomic environment with rates and inflation continues to evolve.

articles.headline: Illinois Tool Works (NYSE:ITW): Is the Next Move About Demand?
